notes: Reviewed October 13, 2026. The author's live manual may change; its text and screenshots are not archived here.
The chapter descriptions summarize the author's material. Abacus has not verified the indicator, its code, or its claimed performance.
Original source: Willy Collins. Reproduction permission was not established; the user selected this brief companion instead of a full copy.

sections.body: Choose a chapter from the contents, then follow its source link for the full text and screenshots. The illustrations below are original educational schematics. This companion does not reproduce the book or establish a trading edge.
